description: Department of Census & Statistics - Notional Consumer Price Index for December, 2019
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index for December 2019, computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content is statistical/economic data publication, which falls under general administrative matters not covered by Types 1-9, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
